study type: prospective, randomized, controlled, double-blinded clinical trial
exposure: Incisional infiltration of 2% lidocaine with epinephrine
cohort: 153 women undergoing Cesarean section under general anesthesia
finding: Administering epinephrine with 2% lidocaine for incisional infiltration prolongs the anesthetic effect and reduces postoperative opioid analgesic requirements, enhancing patient recovery.
